summary.intent: Audit ~77 pending GSD todos against the code delivered in phases 61-69 to identify which were already resolved, retire the resolved ones, and propose a phased roadmap for addressing the rest.
summary.outcome: 8 parallel subagents audited all todos against current source; 12 were confirmed fully resolved and retired (moved to completed/), 4 were partial, ~61 remain open. Retirement commit was corrected onto a docs/chore branch after initially landing on main, and Phases 70-73 of the proposed 10-phase roadmap were written into ROADMAP.md on that same branch.

repo: cipher-box main branch is protected against direct commits — docs/chore-only changes (like todo retirement) must go on a docs/* branch, not main.
client.ts (SDK) has grown to 5,893 LoC (from 2,768), with no pinning.ts/shared-folder.ts/inode/ module split yet — flagged as its own future phase (79) rather than folded into unrelated work.

Several 'resolved' rotation/durability todos (durability-sc4, update-folder-metadata, move-within-scope) had their code fix land but the todo files were never retired from .planning/todos/pending/, showing bookkeeping lags actual landing.

code.finding: Out-of-band reseal under parent's new key implemented — part of rotation-engine-walk-soundness-phase64, now RESOLVED
deleteItem still preserves removed child's WriteChildRef verbatim via getWriteBodyParams — write-link removal explicitly deferred to a future plan (68.1-02), todo remains OPEN
claimInvite still returns existing share id with no grant merge/reject logic — share-invite-reclaim-apply-later-grant remains OPEN
Recovery tool still hard-checks vault blob v2 (0x02) format; both recovery-related todos are duplicates of this same unported file
mergeChildren is pure remote-wins with no localWins flag — concurrent-add CAS-409 re-merge can downgrade a rotated child's readKeySealed, still OPEN

workflow: Fanning out 8 themed audit subagents in parallel (crypto/codec, rotation, write-plane, web share/nav, web misc, share-invite/API, TEE/IPNS/testing, desktop/fuse/infra) let a 77-item backlog get verified against live code in one pass instead of sequentially.
Each audit agent returned a verdict table (OPEN/PARTIAL/RESOLVED) with file:line evidence, which made consolidating resolved-vs-open trivial without re-reading source directly.

friction: Initial retirement commit was made directly on main, violating branch protection; had to be moved to a new docs/ branch and main reset afterward.
Waiting on 8 background subagents produced a long stream of task-notifications arriving out of order, requiring careful tracking of which batch had reported vs was still pending.
open_items: 65 todos remain pending; only Phases 70-73 (rotation soundness, SDK write-plane durability, shared write/nav correctness, share-invite/API integrity) have been written to ROADMAP.md so far — Phases 74-79 were proposed but not yet added.
4 PARTIAL todos left open: web-vitest not in CI, verify-filepointer.mts still missing zeroize, permanent-delete dialog not mode-specific, no-legacy-v1/v2-vault lacking explicit guard comment.
Backlog candidates (ERC-1271 contract-wallet auth, CRDT-IPNS inbox sharing, async/incremental search index, alternative MFA factors) identified but not yet filed via /gsd-capture --backlog.
docs/retire-resolved-todos-61-69 branch has retirement + roadmap commits but no PR opened yet.
Noted dependency ordering for future phases: Phase 77 and 79's client.ts work should run after 70-72 settle; Phase 72 depends on Phase 71's write-plane primitives.
